steps.do:
Check every business savings product against every stated requirement, using the figures in this job's rules: Bronze Saver, Silver Saver, Silver Plus Saver, Gold Saver, Gold Plus Saver, Emerald Saver, Platinum Reserve, Diamond Vault. Keep only the products that meet ALL of them.
- Drop a product whose required minimum balance is above what the customer will commit to keep.
- A product whose documents do not show it meets a requirement (for example a withdrawal allowance or relationship bonus) does not meet it.
- A fee equal to the customer's cap meets the cap.

steps.do:
Choose the account to recommend from the qualifying set, using the date from s_time. If only one account qualifies, choose it. Otherwise work out each active notice's pick:
- November notice pick (active 11/01/2025-11/30/2025): Gold Saver Account if it qualifies, else Silver Plus Saver if it qualifies, else 'any qualifying account'.
- October notice pick (active 10/12/2025-11/12/2025): Gold Plus Saver if it qualifies, else Silver Plus Saver if it qualifies, else 'any qualifying account'.
Then decide:
- One notice active: choose that notice's pick.
- Both active (11/01/2025-11/12/2025): if the two picks name the same account, choose it. If one pick is 'any qualifying account', choose the other notice's named pick, since both notices allow it. If they name different accounts (for example Gold Saver Account and Silver Plus Saver), the documents do not say which notice governs: tell the customer that both accounts meet every requirement and ask which they prefer.
- A pick of 'any qualifying account', or no notice active: no document ranks the accounts. Tell the customer how each qualifying account meets their requirements and ask which they prefer.
steps.quote: (1) Gold Saver Account should be recommended first, as it is currently under promotional priority; (2) Silver Plus Saver should be recommended second, as it is also under promotional priority;

done_when: The customer is verified, earlier in the conversation or here. Every savings requirement has been collected. Eligibility has been confirmed from a fresh account lookup and the current date; a business checking account opened in this conversation does not count. Then one of these is true: (a) one business savings account that meets every requirement (by the active notice's pick, or by the customer's choice where the documents do not settle one) has been opened with its exact class name, and either the confirmed opening deposit has been transferred from the qualifying business checking account or the customer has been told the 30-day funding deadline; (b) the customer has been told why the account cannot be opened; or (c) the customer has been told that no account meets every requirement.
